hero.greeting: Hello! I'm Will, a senior service designer.
hero.tagline: Making sense of complexity through human-centred design.
body: I shape customer experiences and design services that work—for people and for business.

Over the past 5 years at AKQA, I've partnered with leading brands across banking, superannuation, retail, and government to solve complex problems through service design, CX strategy, and digital innovation.
I translate deep human insight into clear strategy, tangible experiences, and scalable service solutions that drive growth, loyalty, and real-world impact.
